dog.description_text: Cider is 4 Months Old and 25 lbs. His favorite things include morning cuddles, following his foster mom everywhere, and attempting to carry around a teething bone that’s almost too big for his little mouth. He’s a loves sleeping, curling up in your lap and tucking his head into your neck for a hug. He has the perfect puppy balance of playtime followed by a very serious nap! This Lab Mix puppy is sweet, eager to learn, and making great progress! He’s recently started going on leash walks and is working on all the usual puppy things, including building his confidence. He would love a home where he can be close to his people and get plenty of affection. He is vaccinated and neutered.
dog.name: Cider
